title: Pilobol.us P3-06: hard switch: reader builds from the CMS export (guest read), Git content path deleted
description:
## Goal
Hard switch: the new reader app builds pilobol.us from the CMS export (guest read, no credentials), and the Git content path is deleted.

## Context (FACT)
- The reader entry reader/build.py (scaffold ticket) takes --content and --out; the generated reader spec (template ticket) installs papyrus-newsroom[markus] with boto3, runs papyrus content export-published --auth guest --out content-export --clean (guest-read ticket, Ryan agreed D2), then the site.json reader.buildCommand. export-published is fail-closed (empty or error fails the build).
- Public values for guest read are plain branch env vars on the reader app: PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT, PAPYRUS_IDENTITY_POOL_ID, PAPYRUS_MEDIA_BUCKET, AWS_REGION (from the new backend's outputs; not secrets).
- Python 3.12 via uv on the Amplify image: unproven (+1 day).
- The Auritus embed is origin-locked; the temporary amplifyapp.com origin will not narrate; fine, the check is on text and bytes.

## Exact steps
1. Set the four env vars on the new reader app branch main (Ryan yes; aws amplify update-branch sends the full map).
2. Pilobol.us PR: git rm web/content/{articles,drafts,effects,a-fungus-among-us.md}; move reader-owned files (JS, CSS, HTML, unreferenced images) from web/content/assets to web/reader-assets and point reader/build.py's overlay there. Merge (Ryan yes); the reader job runs.
3. Verify on https://main.<newReaderAppId>.amplifyapp.com: 94 files; run the byte-diff sanity check of a scratch Git build (tag the old main commit first: git tag pre-cms-cutover) against the new site: identical, or every difference explained.
4. Negative check: a wrong endpoint env value fails the build (then restore).

## Acceptance checks
Reader job SUCCEED from the CMS export; diff-trees --dist <scratch Git build> --live https://main.<id>.amplifyapp.com clean; no Git content path left.

## Rollback
Git history (tag pre-cms-cutover); revert the PR.

## Risks
Python provisioning; the 6 MB-class asset (6,047,745 byte jpeg) is a reader-owned file and unaffected.

## Needs Ryan
Yes for env vars and merge.

## Common rules (Phase 3 Pilobol.us, simplified plan v2)
- Plan: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md (PR AnthusAI/Papyrus#128). Ryan 2026-10-06: Pilobol.us is PRE-PRODUCTION, Git history is the rollback, HARD CUTOVER: no soak, no Git freeze, no dual Git/CMS build path, no parity gate, brief downtime is fine. New Amplify apps are created from the template; the old apps and the old EMPTY backend are retired at the end.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, us-east-1 (SSO is Ryan's). Never print env var or secret VALUES (names only). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally. Creating, changing or deleting AWS resources needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step; deleting data or stacks is done by Ryan (or on his explicit yes).
- Never build in /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us (its build rewrites content): use a fresh clone or a worktree.
- Papyrus repo: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, feature/PPY-<id>-<slug>, PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. Pilobol.us repo: feature branch + PR, never push to its main. In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus only run kbs.
- Keep article text verbatim (the importer already does; narration hashes depend on it). The Auritus embed is origin-locked to the site key's origin; the production origin stays pilobol.us, so nothing changes there (narration will not play on temporary amplifyapp.com URLs: expected).
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link and command output when done.

comments.text: P3-06 progress. (1) Stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us-cms updated: cdk diff showed only ReaderBranch EnvironmentVariables; first deploy failed and rolled back because Amplify rejects env names starting with AWS (AWS_REGION), so reader.environment has PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT, PAPYRUS_IDENTITY_POOL_ID, PAPYRUS_MEDIA_BUCKET only (region derives from the endpoint). Second deploy succeeded; reader app dssc97s4q5kgk still platform WEB, repo anthusai/pilobol.us, same service role; main branch env names: PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT, PAPYRUS_IDENTITY_POOL_ID, PAPYRUS_MEDIA_BUCKET, PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND, SITE_ENV. (2) PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Pilobol.us/pull/50 (feature/PPY-bd249d-reader-from-cms, not merged): web/content deleted, 57 reader-owned files moved to web/reader-assets, reader/build.py fails on empty export, docs updated. Offline proof: guest export (18 items) + reader/build.py = 94 files, diff-trees vs pre-deletion Git build: identical. Bogus endpoint: export-published exit 1. Tag pre-cms-cutover not yet created (previous main 8210c6f).

right_now_summary: The CMS reader setup works, and PR #50 awaits merge after the rollback tag is created.
